Name: JP's Better Tool System
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[font=Georgia][b][i][size=6][color=#00ffff][u][center]Reworked Tool System[/center][/u][/color][/size][/i][/b]

[/font][font=Georgia][color=#ff00ff][size=5][b][i]The iridium axe must be so light that it could cut... Never mind, it has already cut it.[/i][/b][/size][/color][/font][font=Georgia]


[color=#00ff00][size=4][i][b]As you progress through the game, you gain more energy while expending less energy. At the end of the day, you don't even need to use an energy drink to recover your energy; You'll have energy to spare, and it's not like you're going to make a big deal out of it, right? Let's change that a little.[/b][/i][/size][/color][b][size=4][i][color=#00ff00] [/color]
[/i]

I highly recommend installing the “[color=#ff7700][i]Generic Mod Config Menu[/i][/color]” mod so you can customize this mod to your liking and read the descriptions for each section. [i]You can find everything under the mod: "[color=#00ffff](JP98) Reworked Tool System[/color]".[/i]
[/size][/b]

[color=#ffff00][size=5][b][i][u]What this mod does:[/u][/i][/b][/size][/color]

[list]
[*][size=4]Now both the axe and the pickaxe will do [color=#00ffff]the same damage regardless of their upgrade level[/color]. This means that an iridium axe will break a tree in 10 hits, just like an unupgraded one. The same applies to the pickaxe. [color=#ffff00][b][i]Regardless of the upgrade level, they all deal 1 point of damage (originally, an iridium axe would deal 5 points of damage)[/i][/b][/color][/size]
[/list][size=4]
[/size][list]
[*][size=4]Upgrading the pickaxe and axe now [color=#00ffff]reduces their energy consumption[/color] per upgrade through: Base tool, copper, iron, gold, and iridium (2, 1.75, 1.5, 1.25, and 1). In addition, each level will [color=#00ffff]increase the speed[/color] of use, the [b][i]mod's new mechanic[/i][/b]. [/size]
[/list][size=4]
[/size][list]
[*][size=4]The proficiency system, which reduced the energy expended by tools when leveling up a skill (foraging, mining), is replaced by one that increases the speed of the tool when leveling up those skills.[/size]
[/list][size=4]
[/size][list]
[*][size=4]For the speed bonus, both your [color=#00ffff]skill level and the tool's upgrade level[/color] are important for reaching the [color=#00ffff]maximum possible speed[/color] (the skill level represents 45% of the final speed, while the tool improvement only represents 55%).[/size]
[/list][size=4]
[/size][list]
[*][size=4][color=#00ff00]In summary, you can have an iridium axe that takes the same amount of time to chop down trees as an unupgraded one, but is much faster and uses less energy, making it worthwhile to use items that restore energy and carry some in your backpack.[/color] [/size]
[/list][size=4]
[/size][list]
[*][size=4]Something similar happens with the [color=#00ffff]special charge[/color] of the Hoe and Watercan (hold down the action button). As your skill level increases, so does the speed at which each tile pattern passes, especially in the iridium upgrade, where there are three patterns before reaching the last one. [/size]
[/list][size=4]
[/size][list]
[*][size=4]Weapons and Scythes have also been [color=#00ffff]modified in terms of energy consumption[/color]: Swords consume 1 energy, daggers consume 0.5 (and 2 for each special attack), maces consume 2 (and 3 for each special attack and replica when quickly pressing the attack button during the animation). The sickle consumes 2 energy per use, the golden one 1.5, and the iridium one 1. [/size]
[/list]

[size=5][b][i][color=#00ff00]The ultimate goal of this mod is to give a touch of realism and a better use to the energy system, which normally becomes unnecessary as you advance in the game. [/color]
[color=#ffff00]What the video below shows is just one configuration; by default, it won't be that crazy.[/color][color=#00ff00] [/color]

[/i][/b][/size]
[youtube]0mrHxTPq25M[/youtube]


[color=#00ff00][size=5][i][b]That's it. Using GMCM, you'll find descriptions of each configuration so you can see what they contain and make your choices. There are a lot of options to enable, disable, modify... Have fun bringing the game back to life once again. What a great game, my goodness. [/b][/i][/size][/color]


[b][i][color=#ffff00][size=6][u]Translations[/u][/size][/color][/i]
[/b][size=4][b]You are free to translate the mod; [color=#ff0000]you don't need to ask my permission[/color].
You can publish it yourself on Nexusmods or send it to me to integrate it, it's up to you.
If you like, you can also let me know that your translation has been published, so I know you're out there.[/b]
